annotations.text:
A · Sketch grid — the attached sketch, literally.
Two by two at every width, screenshots tilted and broken out of the card top. Reads as a toy shelf.
Tradeoff: at 390px the two-up cards leave ~150px of text width, so the blurbs have to be short — that is the least SEO copy of the three.

B · Marquee row — four abreast, editorial hero.
Left-aligned hero so the h1 and the paragraph read as one block; cards straight-on and equal weight.
Tradeoff: four equal cards say all four tools are equally real. Three of them are not.

C · Featured — the shipped tool leads.
The dex builder gets a split hero card with a real screenshot and a solid CTA; the other three sit in a supporting row.
Tradeoff: it buries the league builder, which is the tool with a settled spec and the next page to rank.

SEO structure, same in all three:
· h1 carries "make your own Pokédex" plus region and league.
· Each card is an <h2> that exactly matches its slug: /custom-pokedex-builder, /pokemon-league-builder, /favorite-pokemon-picker.
· The footer repeats the four links as anchor text.
Watch out: making / a router moves the dex builder off the URL that ranks today (~pos 7.8 for "pokedex builder").

D · Poster cards, settled. Card height is the reference ratio cut a further 20%: 104px on a 166px card at 390. Two screenshots fanned at -8 and -3, back one lower and further left. The gradient is a layer on the card, so it stops at the card outline including the rounded corners.
The artwork's clipping box now reaches 34px further up and left than the artwork needs, so each screenshot's drop shadow falls outside the card without being sliced at the clip edge. Both grid gaps carry that bleed too, so a shadow never lands on the neighbouring card.
The fourth card has no tool to screenshot, so it takes a crossed hammer and wrench in a darker red, sitting just above the card's middle.

One thing to look at before this becomes code: the title sizes are set by "Trainer Card & League Builder" on one line, not by the average.
At 390 two-up, a card is 166px wide, and that title on one line lands at 8.4px — small. Desktop gets 14.4px and tablet 18px, which are fine. Two ways out if 8.4px is too small: give the league card a shorter label, or let mobile cards go one per row and scroll.
One SEO note: "Trainer Card & League Builder" drops the word Pokémon from that card's heading, which was carrying the /pokemon-league-builder match. Worth keeping the full phrase in the markup even if the visible label is this.
I also spelled "psuedo" as "pseudo" in the dex blurb — say the word if that was deliberate.
